summary: Recent relevant listings were concentrated in QCD matter phenomenology and practical physics AI/ML: multidimensional QCD equations of state, bottomonium transport in a strongly coupled QGP, heavy-flavor energy correlators in nuclear matter, GPU normalizing-flow event generation, on-detector ML for muon-collider backgrounds, conditional-flow accelerator surrogates, symbolic-regression law discovery, and validation risks for neural PDE operators.
strongest_paper: 2608.21338: end-to-end GPU normalizing-flow event generation with billion-event benchmarks and up to two orders of magnitude speedup.

papers.title: Thermodynamically Consistent Merging of Multidimensional QCD Equations of State
papers.authors: Prachi Garella, Yumu Yang, Musa R. Khan, Tulio E. Restrepo, Joaquin Grefa, Johannes Jahan, Mauricio Hippert, Jorge Noronha, Claudia Ratti, Romulo Rougemont
papers.abstract: A thermodynamically consistent framework for merging complementary models into a multidimensional QCD equation of state by minimizing a single grand potential at fixed temperature and baryon chemical potential; demonstrated with a quantum van der Waals HRG and holographic EMD model.

papers.title: Bottomonium transport in the sQGP at RHIC and the LHC
papers.authors: Biaogang Wu, Jacob Boyd, Ralf Rapp
papers.abstract: Bottomonium transport in heavy-ion collisions using a kinetic rate equation in 3+1D hydrodynamic QGP evolution, T-matrix rates constrained by lattice QCD, in-medium masses, nine states, and feed-down.

papers.title: Unraveling QCD dynamics with heavy quark energy correlators
papers.abstract: Heavy-quark energy-energy correlators are developed for charm and bottom jet substructure, dead-cone effects, and medium-induced radiation in reactions with nuclei.

papers.title: Efficient Event Generation for High-Multiplicity LHC Processes: An End-to-End GPU Workflow with Normalizing Flows
papers.authors: Enrico Bothmann, Joshua Isaacson, Claudius Krause, Carla J. Lopez-Zurita, Maximilian Spannring, Daohan Wang
papers.abstract: GPU-resident event generation combines normalizing-flow proposals with Pepper, benchmarks high-multiplicity LHC processes, and reports 10^9 unweighted events per benchmark with up to two orders of magnitude speedup.

papers.title: On-Detector Machine Learning for Beam-Induced Background Rejection at a 10 TeV Muon Collider
papers.authors: Daniel Abadjiev, Eliza Howard, Tsz Ngong You, Ryan Michaud, Benjamin Ryan Roberts, et al.
papers.abstract: Lightweight neural networks using pixel-cluster shapes reject beam-induced background in a 10 TeV muon-collider vertex detector, with HLS feasibility and 88-90% data reduction at 99% signal efficiency.

papers.title: Flow-based surrogate models for particle tracking
papers.authors: Matthias Remta, Yann Dutheil, Francesco Velotti
papers.abstract: Conditional-flow-matching surrogates for CERN Proton Synchrotron tracking report MMD^2 of 3e-4, 0.04 s inference, cross-attention gains for space charge, and hybrid anchoring with fewer conventional tracks.

papers.title: NestyNet. III. Symbolic Regression from Analytic Neural Surrogates
papers.authors: Rodrigo Ibata, Wassim Tenachi, Foivos Diakogiannis, Neil Ibata, Anirudh Shankar
papers.abstract: Analytic neural surrogates detect separability and internal coordinates for symbolic regression, with exact noiseless AI Feynman recovery, noisy statistical audit, dimensional analysis, and SPARC real-data testing.

papers.title: Resolving positive semi-definiteness in physics-informed kernels for scientific machine learning
papers.authors: J. Moser, C. Albert, S. Ranftl
papers.abstract: The paper establishes a sufficient differentiability condition for differential-operator-informed kernels to preserve positive semi-definiteness, including non-constant or discontinuous coefficients.

papers.title: Wrong-Physics Backdoors in Neural PDE Operators
papers.abstract: Cross-parameter relinking poisons neural PDE operator training so triggered inputs produce plausible solutions under incorrect physical parameters while retaining low clean error.

papers.title: CDRL: Certification-Driven Reinforcement Learning for Neutrino Flavor Model Discovery
papers.authors: Piyush Jha, Jake Rudolph, Victoria Knapp-Perez, Max Fieg, Aishik Ghosh, Vijay Ganesh
papers.abstract: Reinforcement learning uses symbolic-reasoning certificates to convert model-constraint failures into reusable constraints in neutrino flavor model discovery.
